name: next-steps
description: After each reply, shows suggested next steps as buttons above the prompt (press 1-4 or click).

source.title: Suggestion source
source.description: quick: Haiku reads your last prompt and Claude's reply (cheap, fast). full: forks the whole conversation on the session's model (better, costs more).

onPress.title: When a button is pressed
onPress.description: submit: send the step as your next prompt. fill: put it in the prompt box to edit first.
